name: Hammer curl
notes: Neutral-grip dumbbell curl. Record the load of one dumbbell.

guide.setup: Stand tall holding dumbbells at the sides with palms facing in and elbows close to the ribs.
guide.execution: Curl toward the shoulders keeping the palms facing in, then lower slowly to full elbow extension.
guide.cues: Keep ribs down. Hold the neutral grip throughout. Move at the elbow.
guide.mistakes: Swinging the hips; elbows drifting forward; rotating the wrists to a palms-up curl; shortening the bottom range.
